### Financial Institutions, Inc. Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


October 1, 2026


WARSAW, N.Y., Oct. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Financial Institutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: FISI) (the “Company”), the parent company of Five Star Bank and Courier Capital, LLC, will release results for the third quarter ending September 30, 2026, after the market closes on October 29, 2026.


Management will host an earnings conference call and audio webcast on October 30, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time. The call will be hosted by Martin K. Birmingham, President and Chief Executive Officer, and W. Jack Plants II, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer. Within the United States, participants may access the call by dialing 1-877-425-9470 and requesting the “Financial Institutions, Inc. Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call.” A live webcast will also be available at[https://viavid.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1776786&tp_key=90ac35b0c7](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=htzWBMTEysg4VX9dO7runvsb1dA7Xy9E8EbB34e-hkhz2IB2-dnxLdm68-2f_ZuCGffSyoQrZxhTHD7W0OS8nM1un10aZyCrCOaQdXzbwoQ_TIU8tDxyEtUPTjgwc52Mv2SD0L71srtSMQAV2_gCsRy_kv3UeBnlYHy3qlOB4z6g-99rNFKBqyE-M_T7qEQgGSSr4qj0stp-tmAH8hK9Ia_Svg9JB56AFg7qFgweavY=) in listen-only mode. A replay of the webcast will be available on the Company’s IR website,[www.FISI-Investors.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Rf7MzAyHxZnIRxFQTfWAuqPU9lwVhSaVfN0WyIADLUL8TPoBvM9GRDffT2br1qmMjmPNsM5Xain2zbeGZR982pHH7YpAKIUM9WgcB-1iG4E=) , for at least 30 days.


**About Financial Institutions, Inc.**
Financial Institutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: FISI) is a financial holding company with approximately $6.3 billion in assets as of June 30, 2026, offering banking and wealth management products and services. Its Five Star Bank subsidiary provides consumer and commercial banking and lending services to individuals, municipalities and businesses through banking locations spanning Western and Central New York and a commercial loan production office serving the Mid-Atlantic region. Courier Capital, LLC offers customized investment management, financial planning and consulting services to individuals and families, businesses, institutions, non-profits and retirement plans. Learn more at Five-StarBank.com and FISI-Investors.com.
